posts.text:
Lindsey Graham defined the word patriot.  He was a strong advocate for freedom and a friend.  His passion for South Carolina and the United States were unmatched. 

I am deeply saddened by this loss to our nation.

Susanne and I are praying for his family and team. He will be greatly missed.
